cards.title: Culture Surrounding 'Ideal' Childbirth Must Evolve
cards.body: Letters respond to an article about a five-day labour, with an NHS doctor sharing her experience of feeling 'othered' during childbirth. The discussion highlights how cultural expectations around 'ideal' birth experiences need to change.

cards.title: Should AI Really Do Your Parenting Job?
cards.body: Tech companies offer eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts, and 'optimized nap predictions' for parents. The article questions whether busy parents actually need these AI tools or if they're unnecessary additions to an already demanding job.

cards.title: The '18 Summers' Parenting Trend: Creepy or Clever?
cards.body: The trend turns summer holidays into scheduled 'memory-making' exercises rather than allowing children long days of unstructured free time. Some argue this modern parenting approach is controlling and misses the whole point of summer breaks.

cards.title: Finding Hope When Your Child Has Eating Disorder
cards.body: A new book for families addresses common misconceptions about eating disorders and provides practical guidance for supporting recovery. It offers evidence-based approaches to help parents navigate their child's eating challenges.

cards.title: What Children Actually Need to Thrive in 2026
cards.body: New school year brings rules about devices and AI, but the real question is about what children need to flourish. The focus should shift from technology restrictions to understanding genuine developmental needs.

cards.title: Swimming Lessons 'Vital' as Schools Gap Revealed
cards.body: New data shows how schools are performing on teaching life-saving swimming skills in the English curriculum. Experts emphasize the importance of these lessons for child safety.

cards.title: Trump Signs Order to Limit Childhood Vaccines
cards.body: The administration recommends splitting MMR shots, which the American Academy of Pediatrics calls 'dangerous.' Medical experts warn this policy could harm children's health protection.

cards.title: Canada Flight Cancelled Over Child Seat Belt Dispute
cards.body: A flight was cancelled after a child refused to wear a seat belt, sparking debate over child safety and discipline on planes. The incident highlights tensions between parenting approaches and airline safety requirements.
